title: The Day of the Backwards Hat
skyStory: At sixty-nine percent and swelling, the moon is still in Leo and has decided to wear its crown backwards, just to see who notices. Leo loves an entrance and a bit of swagger. The peepers have started singing in the marshes, and the lion assumes they are singing about it. Saturn does not have the heart to correct it.

reading: Yesterday you were on stage. Today the lion moon wants you backstage, checking the ropes. It is less glamorous, but the show depends on it.

Check one boring system you rely on: the batteries in the smoke detector, the stack of half-read mail, the drawer with forty mystery keys. Fix one. The [[Eight of Pentacles]] is sitting at a workbench nearby, sanding something patiently, humming along to the peepers. Craft is a kind of love. When you are done, walk outside after dark and listen. The marsh choir is louder than it was last week.
joel.mission: Sort one drawer of mystery objects at home and throw away exactly three things nobody will miss.
joel.omen: The peepers singing for the first time where you live. It means spring has officially signed in.

reading: You will see someone wearing something backwards or inside out today, and you will be the only one who notices. Do you tell them? The Wood Rat says yes, gently, with a wink.

That small kindness sets the tone for the whole day. Around 2 pm, you will have a chance to save someone from a tiny embarrassment, a typo, a loose tag, a forgotten coffee on a roof. Swoop in. The Leo moon makes you fearless today, but with a Capricorn's precision. You do not need applause. You will get a grateful look, and that is better.
nancy.mission: Gently tell one person about a tag sticking out, a typo, or a mug left behind, with a smile.
nancy.omen: A hat or cap left on a bench. It means someone needs your sharp eyes today, so look around.

together.text: Wear one item backwards or on the wrong side today, a hat, a sock, a bracelet, and see who notices first. Report at bedtime. If nobody does, the lion moon is personally offended and will be louder tomorrow.

game.intro: Backwards hat day. The crew is answering backwards too. Wrong answers only, bonus for style.
game.question: In which direction does the sun rise?
